nodes.name: RoadmapContainers.tsx
nodes.summary: React Flow custom node types for visual grouping containers used in the roadmap graph: cluster boxes and stage bands.

nodes.name: RoadmapVectorGraph.tsx
nodes.summary: Core React Flow-based roadmap visualization: computes a dynamic layered layout of roadmap nodes/edges by stage, renders zoom controls and a sticky stage header.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements a custom hierarchical layout algorithm (getDynamicLayoutedElements) grouping nodes by learning stage and parent chains rather than using a generic graph layout library.

nodes.name: ZoomSlider
nodes.summary: Renders a zoom control slider synced with the React Flow viewport zoom level.

nodes.name: StageStickyHeader
nodes.summary: Renders a sticky header showing the current visible learning stage based on scroll/viewport position.

nodes.name: getDynamicLayoutedElements
nodes.summary: Computes node positions and cluster/stage grouping boxes for the roadmap graph using a custom hierarchical column layout algorithm keyed by learning stage.

nodes.name: RoadmapVectorGraph
nodes.summary: Top-level React Flow canvas component rendering the laid-out roadmap nodes/edges, handling node click callbacks and optimistic status overrides.

nodes.name: StageLegend.tsx
nodes.summary: Small legend component listing roadmap learning stages with their associated colors, used alongside the roadmap graph.

nodes.name: StageLegend
nodes.summary: Renders a color-coded legend of learning stages sourced from STAGE_LEGEND.

nodes.name: StudentProfileSetupModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-field onboarding modal collecting student profile details (career interest, date of birth, etc.) inside the OnboardingShell, submitting via the dashboard services.

nodes.name: StudentProfileSetupModal
nodes.summary: Manages profile form state and validation, submits student profile data, and renders the onboarding shell with profile fields.

nodes.name: getCareerCategory
nodes.summary: Derives a display category/grouping label from a career object.

nodes.name: Field
nodes.summary: Local labeled field wrapper rendering label, hint/error text, and children input.

nodes.name: StudentRoadmapPageView.tsx
nodes.summary: Main student roadmap page: orchestrates career selection, the roadmap graph, curriculum panel, recommendations, resource viewer, and skill/profile modals into a single dashboard view.
nodes.languageNotes: Large orchestration component (600+ lines) composing many feature sub-components and normalizing API response shapes with helper functions.

nodes.name: unwrapProfile
nodes.summary: Unwraps a possibly-nested API response envelope to get the raw student profile object.

nodes.name: getProfileCareerId
nodes.summary: Extracts the selected career ID from a student profile object.

nodes.name: getProfileCareerName
nodes.summary: Extracts the selected career display name from a student profile object.

nodes.name: CareerSelector
nodes.summary: Renders a searchable dropdown for choosing/changing the student's target career, with save/cancel actions.

nodes.name: getLinkMeta
nodes.summary: Parses a raw resource link value into metadata used for rendering resource links.

nodes.name: StudentRoadmapPageView
nodes.summary: Top-level page component that loads dashboard data and composes the roadmap graph, panels, and modals for the student roadmap experience.

nodes.name: StudentSkillSelectionModal.tsx
nodes.summary: Onboarding modal for selecting the student's known skills, part of the OnboardingShell flow, submitting selections via dashboard services.

nodes.name: StudentSkillSelectionModal
nodes.summary: Manages skill selection state, loads available skills, and submits the chosen skills through the onboarding flow.

nodes.name: RoadmapProgressContext.tsx

nodes.name: RoadmapProgressProvider
nodes.summary: Context provider component that holds and exposes roadmap progress state to its subtree.

nodes.name: useRoadmapProgress
nodes.summary: Hook for consuming the RoadmapProgressContext, throwing if used outside the provider.

nodes.name: useDashboardData.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook for fetching and managing student dashboard data (roadmap/profile) state used by the student dashboard page.

nodes.name: useDashboardData
nodes.summary: Fetches student dashboard data and exposes loading/error/data state to consuming components.

nodes.name: useStudentSetup.ts
nodes.summary: Custom hook driving the student onboarding/setup flow (profile + skill selection), coordinating calls to studentDashboardService.

nodes.name: getProfileCareerId
nodes.summary: Extracts the career ID from a profile-like object for setup flow logic.

nodes.name: useStudentSetup
nodes.summary: Manages the multi-step student setup/onboarding process state and submission calls.

nodes.name: stageColors.ts
nodes.summary: Central definitions for roadmap learning-stage ordering, colors, labels, and legend metadata used across roadmap visualization components.
